reviews.text: I was trying to buy a pet stroller and asked some questions, but the staff member's explanation was sloppy and unhelpful. I also asked about other products, but they didn't explain them carefully. I hope they reconsider their customer service attitude.

I purchased a harness at "Pet Paradise," a pet supply store inside Aqua City Odaiba.

I was worried about choosing the right size, but the staff were very helpful and patiently checked the fit while I tried it on, which made me feel confident in my choice.

The product explanations were easy to understand, and I was impressed by how thoroughly they explained the features and usage of each item.

I felt this is a store that even first-time harness buyers can use with confidence.
The staff gather together and chat, which is very unpleasant. It has a foreign atmosphere. I used to go there often when it was the Venus Fort store, but I never want to go there again.
If you're shopping in Odaiba and want to be pampered by cats, this is the place to go. There are always a few cats around.

The selection of goods is good.
However, the attitude of some of the staff is...bad,
and sometimes it makes me feel sad.
I want to have a pleasant shopping experience, and I think everyone is excited when they enter a store, right? But when they act like that, it casts a shadow over the mood of visiting on a day off.
After waiting a while,
a different staff member came,
and I was able to shop comfortably after that, but it's always disappointing because it's a store I like.
